text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The Umamusume Ogura Hyakunin Isshu." 
Compiled during the late Edo period based 
on the Ogura Hyakunin Isshu, this poetry 
anthology—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—contains poems about Umamusume, as well 
as works by Umamusume poets depicting 
their romance and daily lives, serving as 
an invaluable historical record of that 
era.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"So, the fortune you'd like me to divine 
is 'How to make everyone happy in the New 
Year'!\nThat's correct, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, sir-ee... I've been such a klutz all 
year and caused so much trouble for 
everyone..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"So next year, I—I want to bring happiness 
to everyone!\nEven though it's... totally 
presumptuous of someone like me...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, not presumptuous at all!\nThat's 
a truly wonderful aspiration!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, I also want to make the New Year 
a happy one—I will assist you with all my 
might! Now then, let's divine your fortune 
right away!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ungyara~... mongyara~...\nKashikomi~~... 
makikomi~~..."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: "KIYAAAAAAAHHH!!!!\nHYOEEEEEE~~!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh, an auspicious sign has appeared! 
Thank you, Shiraoi-sama!\nThe direction is 
northeast! I see tatami mats!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, joining forces with your 
friends to take on a competitive contest 
will bring Super Ultra Great Luck~~~~!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Display event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-A-And so, that's why I-I've gathered 
everyone here today!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"A competition with everyone?! That sounds 
so exciting!\nWhat are we doing? What are 
we doing?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Well, you see—ta-da, feast your 
eyes!\nIt's the New Year tradition, the 
'Umamusume Karuta Tournament', using the 
Umamusume Hyakunin Isshu!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oho, karuta! That legendary game where 
countless Umamusume have clashed since 
ancient times, cards flying and tatami 
scorched by the blazing friction of 
drifting!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I've seen that on TV!\nKaruta is that 
game where everyone fights to grab those 
giant cards, right?!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, that's the one! Teams of Umamusume 
sprinting all over a massive arena, 
running wild! Such a joyous, celebratory 
tradition!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, I had no idea what kind of 
'competition with friends' we should do... 
so I went to consult with Ms. Tazuna."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And then—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"COMMENDABLE!\nTo strive for 
self-improvement right at the dawn of the 
New Year is truly magnificent!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"THEREFORE, A PROPOSAL!\nSpeaking of the 
New Year, Tazuna, there is that annual 
event."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Yes♪\nThe 'All-Japan Umamusume Karuta 
Tournament', which the URA co-sponsors."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume Karuta is a four-person team 
sport where massive grabbing cards are 
laid out across a vast arena using the 
Umamusume Hyakunin Isshu."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"The Academy serves as a registration 
window, so if you wish, you can register a 
team of four or more participants♪"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Umamusume Karuta demands 'running power', 
'intellect', and 'teamwork'.\nPerhaps due 
to its difficulty, participant numbers 
have dwindled in recent years, however..."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"ENCOURAGEMENT! Securing a practice area, 
tournament registration, event attire—the 
Academy shall support it all! I wish you 
the best of luck!!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Bwahahaha! Magnificent! At the dawn of 
the New Year, the miraculously blessed New 
Overlord and her companions! Broadcast 
live on national television!!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds like fun! I wanna play, I wanna 
play!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Wonderful, everyone is so enthusiastic! 
Well then, so that we may all attain 
happiness, let's register our team right 
away!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"As for our team name—let's see,\nhow 
about Team <New Year Super Ultra Great Luck Fukukitaru>!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(T-Thank goodness... Everyone agreed to 
join...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Now, I just need to not mess up and 
actually be useful...\nIt's about 'joining 
forces with friends', so I have to pull my 
own weight!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(Ayabe-san...! She's always training 
alongside me, and yet I keep tripping and 
causing her trouble...)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(I... I want Ayabe-san to be happy 
too...!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Um... A-A-Ayabe-san...!\nDo you, um, have 
a moment to spare right now...?!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "Doto? What is it?"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Um, well, you see... over New Year's, I'm 
going to enter a karuta tournament 
together with Fukukitaru-san and the 
others."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"A fortune told us that entering the 
tournament would bring happiness to 
'everyone'.\nSo, I was wondering if you'd 
like to join us, Ayabe-san..."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"This past year... I've caused you so much 
trouble with all my clumsy mistakes, 
Ayabe-san... So—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I really want you to be happy too, 
Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Doto...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...\nSorry, but I'll pass."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I want to focus on my races right now... 
See you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
(...D-Did I make her angry?\nWas it just 
annoying for someone like me to invite her 
after all...?)
